candidates.name: Saint Nicholas Ukrainian Orthodox parish in Boliden
candidates.reason: The official UOC source documents the parish and consecrated church in 2017. Current 2026 UOC reporting names the Stockholm and Gothenburg parishes and nearby missionary centers, but does not identify Boliden as current. Retain pending direct evidence that the parish remains active.

candidates.name: Unnamed UOC missionary centers near Gothenburg
candidates.reason: Current official UOC reporting confirms multiple missionary centers around Gothenburg, but gives no names, cities, patrons, addresses, or stable schedules. They cannot yet be separated into reliable directory rows.

candidates.name: Eight additional OCU worship cities in Sweden
candidates.reason: The official OCU diocesan source says its Swedish community serves nine cities, but names only the Stockholm parish. The other eight cities and any permanent local bodies are not identified.

candidates.name: OCU worship activity in Nykoping
candidates.reason: A published chaplain mission documents a service in Nykoping, but no official OCU source establishes a permanent parish, mission, chapel, or recurring worship site there.

candidates.name: Saint George Serbian Orthodox Parish in Sodertalje
candidates.reason: The older official diocesan contact page lists the parish. It is absent from the Swedish authority's 2024 Serbian Orthodox congregation report and from current central Serbian listings reviewed for Sweden. Retain pending current diocesan confirmation.

candidates.name: Saint Ignatios worship site at Sankt Ignatios College
candidates.reason: A Swedish discovery directory labels the site Georgian, and the official UOC source confirms a college chapel where Georgian clergy were present. Neither source establishes it as a separate Georgian parish or mission, so it is held for parent-church verification.

candidates.name: Russian Orthodox worship activity in Arboga
candidates.reason: Older official news documented worship in Arboga, but the current national parish list and map do not identify an Arboga parish, mission, chapel, or recurring worship site.

candidates.name: Saint Sigfrid and Raphael Orthodox community in Linkoping
candidates.reason: The independent Swedish service directory labels the body Antiochian. The current official Antiochian Sweden parish list does not include it, and no parent-church source found in this audit establishes its canonical assignment or permanent status.

candidates.name: ROCOR Western Rite communities formerly reported in Sweden
candidates.reason: Older secondary accounts report ROCOR Western Rite communities in Sweden. The current official ROCOR global, diocesan, and Western Rite directories list no Sweden body. Retain only as a historical lead pending current official evidence.

superseded_or_not_current.name: Saint Anna of Novgorod Parish under the Serbian Orthodox Church
superseded_or_not_current.reason: The older Serbian diocesan directory lists Saint Anna in Linkoping. The parish's current site places it under the Georgian Patriarchate and in Stockholm. The current Georgian row is published instead.

superseded_or_not_current.name: Transfiguration Parish in Stockholm under the Russian Tradition Archdiocese
superseded_or_not_current.reason: The parish formerly belonged to the Russian Tradition in Western Europe and its own current site says it entered the Bulgarian Patriarchate in 2019. The Bulgarian Patriarchate directory separately names the Saint Paisius of Hilendar church community at the same Stockholm address. Saint Paisius is published from the Patriarchate list, but this website is withheld from that row until an official source establishes whether the two names describe one current body.
